label: meaningful
label_meaning: meaningful: built from the seller's own published schema

coverage.description: 0..1 fraction of the rubric that actually ran; meaningless to read score without it

freshness.description: checked_at/age_seconds/stale. Pass max_age=<seconds> to get `unknown` + STALE_FOR_CALLER instead of an old answer — the observation still travels, so that response is billed normally. The scored fields are absent entirely (not null) on an `unknown` where we have no answer, and that one is free.

reasons.description: stable machine-readable causes behind the verdict; see /v1/methodology → reason_codes

verdict.description: decision-shaped: ok = proceed, caution = hold, avoid = abort, unknown = not rated (never read as safe)

verdict_reason.description: prose; wording not stable — branch on reasons[].code

attribution.derived_from: the schema and example output the seller publicly lists there
attribution.status: unclaimed: the owner can claim or remove the matching listing on the discovery board
